leave_behind.item: utilityServiceFact / ParcelFactSheet.utilityService: modeled here as a single FLAT fact ({provider, serviceType, display}). Factory-side evidence suggested list-shaped companion rows, which turned out to be imprecise on both sides once checked against the actual merged LDT code (legacy-design-tools PR #600, merged 2026-09-04T11:04:56Z, artifacts/api-server/src/lib/utilityServiceFactRead.ts): the real served 'present' shape is a FLAT object with two independently-nullable NAMED sub-fields, water: Entry|null and sewer: Entry|null (Entry = {ccnNo, utility, status, ccnType}) -- neither a single scalar provider nor an array. Additionally, ELECTRIC IS ABSENT from this type entirely, despite parcel_record carrying it at 100% coverage per the ACQUIRE-GIS/wave2 close (companionBreakdownByType.electric=981405) -- status of an electric addition to this type is unconfirmed, ask the LDT lane directly. No gate verdict has been computed for utilityService as of this close, so nothing is live yet -- there is still time to remodel before this reaches production.
